description: Source file implementing the MltAnalyzer class for memory leak analysis and logging, including methods for setting filenames, inserting and removing memory blocks, analyzing memory distribution, and logging results.

classes.name: MltAnalyzer
classes.description: Class for analyzing and logging memory allocations, detecting leaks, and managing related data structures.

methods.name: SetFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename for logging, appending '3' to the postfix and configuring related handlers.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a memory block into tracking, optionally collecting backtrace if enabled.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a tracked memory block, handling potential mismatches or corruption.

methods.name: GetHAHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the header information for a given memory pointer.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Performs analysis of current memory distribution, compares with previous, and logs results.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs the list of not deallocated objects exceeding a threshold for a given iteration.
